# webhook-relay

> Store-and-forward webhook relay: verify an inbound HMAC-SHA256 signature, queue in bounded memory and deliver with re-signing, exponential backoff and a dead-letter list Go module `github.com/Trysac/u155-webhook-relay`, package `webhookrelay`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
